description: Get the median (p50) yearly total compensation in USD for a job family in one location, across all levels, from submissions in the last 12 months. This is the figure to quote for one location's pay; get-location-stats ranks locations over a longer window, so its medians can differ. For one company's pay by level, use get-salaries-by-company-level instead. Free limit: Median (p50) total compensation for one job family in one location. No other percentiles, sample size, level split, or company, focus area or funding filters. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug, countrySlug, companySlug): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, locationSlug.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlug.description: One location slug (metro, state, country or region; not a city), e.g. "san-francisco-bay-area". Resolve it with search-locations first; for a city, use its parent metro.

name: get-salary-percentiles
